title: Vegan Ukrainian Noodle Dish
description: A hearty, comforting Ukrainian-inspired noodle dish made without any animal products.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes, or until they're tender.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a small pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Combine the cooked noodles, mushroom-carrot mixture, and parsley oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
